title_zh: 理解食物渴望與攝取的個人化方法：一項研究計畫
summary_zh: 這項研究旨在透過更精準的方式，了解不同個體在食物渴望和攝取上的差異。研究將追蹤參與者六個月，結合自我報告、生理數據（如腦波）和時間序列動態數據，利用機器學習找出具有獨特飲食和體重變化模式的群體。研究人員將使用可解釋的人工智慧技術，找出區分這些群體的關鍵因素，例如壓力、情緒調節困難或睡眠不足等，進而深入了解影響飲食行為和體重管理的個人化因素。這項研究有助於開發更精準的飲食干預策略，以預防和管理常態及異常的飲食行為。
applications: 想像一下，未來我們可以透過簡單的腦波檢測和問卷，了解你為什麼特別容易嘴饞，是因為壓力大、睡不好，還是其他原因。這樣就能針對你的狀況，提供個人化的飲食建議，讓你更容易控制體重。
這個研究就像幫你量身打造一個飲食教練。如果你的小孩特別挑食或暴飲暴食，這個研究可以幫助醫生或營養師找出背後的原因，例如是不是因為情緒問題或感官敏感，然後給予更有效的協助。
現在很多減肥方法都是一體適用，但其實每個人的身體狀況和生活習慣都不一樣。這個研究可以幫助我們了解哪些減肥方法對哪些人有效，讓減肥不再是盲人摸象，而是真正找到適合自己的方式。

title: Prediction of depression risk in middle-aged and elderly Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic syndrome patients by social and environmental determinants of health: an interpretable machine learning approach using longitudinal data from China.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic (CKM) syndrome is a systemic disease characterized by pathophysiological interactions between the cardiovascular system, chronic kidney disease, and metabolic risk factors. In China, the prevalence of CKM in middle-aged and elderly patients is relatively high. The current research lacks an exploration into the impact of social and environmental determinants of health on depression in CKM patients.
OBJECTIVE: This study aims to construct a depression risk prediction model for middle-aged and elderly CKM patients by social and environmental determinants of health.
METHODS: In this study, 3220 participants were included and collected from three waves of the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). A depression risk prediction model for middle-aged and elderly CKM patients was constructed by using 10 machine learning models. Additionally, the mediating effect of NO2 between arthritis and depression outcomes was analyzed in this population.
RESULTS: An interpretable machine learning model framework was constructed to predict depression risk in middle-aged and elderly CKM patients using the longitudinal cohort data from CHARLS. The RF model demonstrated strong performance in predicting the training set, and the Xgboost model exhibited excellent generalization ability. The presence of arthritis showed a significant independent effect on depression outcomes, with an average direct effect of - 8.5559. The total effect of arthritis on depression outcomes was - 9.5162. The mediating effect of NO2 represented 10.09% of the total effect (average), indicating that NO2 serves as a mediator between arthritis and depression outcomes.
CONCLUSIONS: A depression risk prediction model for middle-aged and elderly CKM patients was developed based on the CHARLS longitudinal data from 2011 to 2015. The SHAP framework was used to provide machine learning model explanations. Intervention strategies that address social and environmental determinants of health are needed. Potential strategies include enhancing urban greening to reduce NO2 levels, integrating CKM as a special outpatient chronic disease to alleviate the financial burdens of patients, and focusing on the treatment of arthritis and digestive diseases in CKM patients.

title_zh: 利用可解釋性機器學習方法，基於中國縱向數據預測中老年心血管-腎臟-代謝綜合症患者的憂鬱症風險：社會和環境健康決定因素
summary_zh: 本研究旨在利用社會和環境健康決定因素，為中老年心血管-腎臟-代謝綜合症（CKM）患者構建憂鬱症風險預測模型。研究使用了中國健康與退休縱向研究（CHARLS）的數據，納入3220名參與者，並採用10種機器學習模型構建預測模型。結果顯示，隨機森林（RF）模型在訓練集上表現出色，而Xgboost模型則展現了良好的泛化能力。此外，關節炎對憂鬱症有顯著的獨立影響，而二氧化氮（NO2）在關節炎和憂鬱症之間起中介作用。研究建議，應針對社會和環境健康決定因素制定干預策略，例如增加城市綠化以降低NO2水平，將CKM納入特殊慢性疾病門診以減輕患者經濟負擔，並重視CKM患者的關節炎和消化系統疾病治療。
applications: 假設您是社區健康中心的負責人，這個研究可以幫助您快速篩選出CKM患者中，哪些人有較高的憂鬱症風險，以便及早提供心理支持和輔導。
想像一下，您是健康保險公司的產品經理，這項研究可以幫助您設計更精準的保險方案，針對CKM患者提供更全面的身心健康保障。
如果您是城市規劃師，這個研究提醒您，改善城市環境，例如增加綠地、減少空氣污染，不僅能促進身體健康，也能降低憂鬱症的發生率。

title: A 3D generation framework using diffusion model and reinforcement learning to generate multi-target compounds with desired properties.
summary: Deep generative models provide a powerful solution for the de novo design of molecules. However, the majority of existing methods only generate molecules for a single target. Generating molecules with biological activities against multiple specific targets and desired properties remains an extremely difficult challenge. In this study, we propose a novel 3D molecule generation framework based on reinforcement learning and diffusion model to generate molecules with predefined properties for given multiple targets. The proposed framework, MDRL, uses a diffusion model to understand the 3D chemical structure of molecules and employs Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks instead of Multilayer Perceptron to enhance model performance. Through reinforcement learning, the framework is able to generate molecules that simultaneously target two targets and further optimizes multiple molecular properties. Experimental results show that our model exhibits comparable performance to various state-of-the-art molecular generation models, and MDRL can effectively navigate chemical space to design polypharmacological compounds and control multiple molecular properties. In multiple case studies, we verify that the generated molecules can simultaneously target two targets through molecular docking and assess the model's ability to control multiple molecular properties. The results in this study highlight the advantages and practicalities of our model in generating polypharmacological compounds with desired properties.

title_zh: 一個利用擴散模型與強化學習的3D生成框架，用於生成具有所需特性的多靶點化合物
summary_zh: 本研究提出一個創新的3D分子生成框架，結合強化學習與擴散模型，旨在設計針對多個靶點且具備特定性質的分子。此框架名為MDRL，利用擴散模型理解分子的3D化學結構，並使用Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN)取代多層感知器(MLP)以提升模型效能。透過強化學習，MDRL能夠生成同時針對兩個靶點的分子，並進一步優化多種分子特性。實驗結果顯示，MDRL的性能與現有最先進的分子生成模型相當，且能有效地探索化學空間，設計多重藥理化合物，並控制多種分子特性。案例研究驗證了生成的分子能同時鎖定兩個目標，並評估了模型控制多重分子特性的能力。本研究強調了MDRL在生成具有所需特性的多重藥理化合物方面的優勢與實用性。
applications: 想像一下，我們生病的時候，常常需要吃很多種藥。這個新技術就像一個聰明的設計師，可以一次設計出一種藥，同時治療多種疾病，減少我們吃藥的種類和副作用。
現在新藥開發很慢又很貴。這個技術就像一個快速的設計工具，可以加速找到有潛力的藥物候選人，節省時間和金錢，讓更多人能更快用到新藥。
有些疾病很複雜，需要同時針對身體裡面的多個目標下手才能有效治療。這個技術就像一個精準的導彈，可以設計出同時攻擊多個目標的藥物，讓治療效果更好。

title: Matrix stiffness-induced IKBKE and MAPK8 signaling drives a phenotypic switch from DCIS to invasive breast cancer.
summary: Ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) is not life threatening unless it transitions into invasive breast cancer (IBC). However, although breast cancer cell exposure to matrix stiffening in vitro phenotypically mimics the DCIS to IBC switch, the molecular changes driving this switch remains unclear. Here, breast cancer cell kinome activity profiling suggested matrix stiffness-upregulation of 53 kinases, among which 16 kinases were also regulated by integrin β1. Functional validation identified matrix stiffness-activation of inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa-B kinase subunit epsilon (IKBKE) and mitogen-activated protein kinase 8 (MAPK8) signaling as critical for the stiffness-driven IBC phenotype, including for cell proliferation. The IKBKE-inhibitor Amlexanox, clinically utilized for aphthous ulcers, as well as the MAPK8 inhibitor JNK-IN-8, reinstalled the DCIS-like phenotype of breast cancer cells on high matrix stiffness. This suggests that IKBKE and/or MAPK8 inhibitors could enhance the arsenal of treatments to prevent or treat breast cancer.

title_zh: 基質硬度誘導IKBKE和MAPK8信號傳導驅動從原位導管癌到侵襲性乳腺癌的表型轉變
summary_zh: 原位導管癌（DCIS）本身不致命，但若轉變為侵襲性乳腺癌（IBC）則會危及生命。研究發現，乳腺癌細胞暴露於較硬的細胞外基質時，會模擬DCIS到IBC的轉變，但其分子機制尚不明確。本研究通過激酶活性分析，發現基質硬度會上調53種激酶，其中16種也受整合素β1調控。功能驗證確定了IKBKE和MAPK8信號通路的激活對於基質硬度驅動的IBC表型至關重要，包括細胞增殖。臨床上用於治療口瘡性潰瘍的IKBKE抑制劑Amlexanox以及MAPK8抑制劑JNK-IN-8，能夠在高基質硬度下使乳腺癌細胞恢復到DCIS樣表型。這表明IKBKE和/或MAPK8抑制劑可能增強預防或治療乳腺癌的治療手段。
applications: 如果未來開發出針對IKBKE或MAPK8的藥物，或許能幫助早期乳腺癌患者，阻止癌細胞擴散，就像在高速公路上設置路障，防止汽車開出車道一樣。
這項研究發現癌細胞喜歡硬的環境，就像某些人喜歡住在堅固的房子裡一樣。我們可以開發讓癌細胞周圍環境變軟的藥物，讓癌細胞不舒服，進而抑制它們的生長和擴散。
我們可以利用這項研究的發現，開發新的乳腺癌檢測方法。如果能早期檢測到IKBKE和MAPK8信號通路的異常激活，就能更早地發現乳腺癌的轉移風險，及早進行干預。

title: Decoding diabetic kidney disease: a comprehensive review of interconnected pathways, molecular mediators, and therapeutic insights.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a chronic kidney condition that arises from prolonged hyperglycaemia that can progress to kidney failure, severe morbidity, and mortality if left untreated. It is the major cause of chronic kidney disease among people who have diabetes, accounting for a significant percentage of patients with end-stage kidney disease who require kidney replacement therapy.
MAIN BODY: In DKD, numerous dysbalanced metabolic, haemodynamic, inflammatory signalling pathways, and molecular mediators interconnect, creating a feedback loop that promotes general kidney damage. Hyperglycaemia is the primary trigger for DKD and leads gradually to oxidative stress, inflammation, extracellular matrix deposition and fibrosis, glomerular hypertension, and intrarenal hypoxia. Key interconnected metabolic pathways are the hyperglycaemia-mediated polyol, hexosamine, protein kinase C, and advanced glycation end-products pathway hyperactivity. Concurrently, hyperglycaemia-induced renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system stimulation, alters the kidney intraglomerular haemodynamic leading to inflammation through Toll-like receptors, Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription, and nuclear factor-kappa B, transforming growth factor-beta-mediated excessive extracellular matrix accumulation and fibrosis. The resulting death signals trigger apoptosis and autophagy through Hippo, Notch, and Wnt/β-catenin pathway activation and microRNA dysregulation. These signals synergistically remodel the kidneys culminating in intrarenal hypoxia, podocyte dysfunction, hyperfiltration, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and loss of kidney function. The resulting renal failure further upregulates these death pathways and mediators, giving rise to a vicious cycle that further worsens DKD.
CONCLUSION: This review provides an overview of the primary molecular mediators and signalling pathways leading to DKD; their interconnectivity at the onset and during DKD progression, the central role of transforming growth factor-beta via different pathways, the Hippo pathway kidney-specific response to hyperglycaemia, and how all mediators and transduction signals result in a vicious circle that exacerbates renal failure. The review gives therapeutic sights to these pathways as druggable targets for DKD management. Understanding these molecular events underlying the pathogenesis of DKD can bridge basic research and clinical application, facilitating the development of innovative management strategies.

title_zh: 解碼糖尿病腎病：互連通路、分子介質與治療見解之全面回顧
summary_zh: 糖尿病腎病是因長期高血糖引起的慢性腎臟疾病，若未治療可能導致腎衰竭。此疾病涉及多種失衡的代謝、血流動力學和發炎訊號通路。高血糖是主要觸發因素，導致氧化壓力、發炎、細胞外基質沉積和纖維化。多種關鍵代謝途徑被激活，同時腎素-血管收縮素-醛固酮系統受到刺激，進而引發炎症反應和過度細胞外基質積累。死亡訊號觸發細胞凋亡和自噬，最終導致腎臟重塑、腎功能喪失，並形成惡性循環，加劇腎衰竭。本研究綜述了導致糖尿病腎病的主要分子介質和訊號通路，以及轉化生長因子-β在此疾病進展中的核心作用，為糖尿病腎病的治療提供了潛在的藥物靶點，有助於開發創新療法。
applications: 場景一：開發新藥。這個研究釐清了糖尿病腎病惡化的原因，就像找到了壞掉的電路圖，藥廠可以根據這個圖，設計出精準的藥物，修復這些壞掉的迴路，阻止腎功能繼續惡化。
場景二：個人化醫療。研究發現不同人腎臟受損的機制可能略有不同，就像同樣是感冒，有些人是病毒感染，有些人是細菌感染。醫生可以透過檢測相關的分子指標，了解患者的具體情況，從而制定更個人化的治療方案。
場景三：早期篩檢。研究中提到的某些分子變化，可能在腎臟還沒出現明顯問題前就發生了。所以，我們可以開發更敏感的檢測方法，及早發現高風險人群，及早介入治療，延緩甚至阻止糖尿病腎病的發生。

title: Are presentations of thoracic CT performed on admission to the ICU associated with mortality at day-90 in COVID-19 related ARDS?
summary:
BACKGROUND: Computed tomography (CT) analysis of lung morphology has significantly advanced our understanding of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). During the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, CT imaging was widely utilized to evaluate lung injury and was suggested as a tool for predicting patient outcomes. However, data specifically focused on patients with ARDS admitted to intensive care units (ICUs) remain limited.
METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed patients admitted to ICUs between March 2020 and November 2022 with moderate to severe COVID-19 ARDS. All CT scans performed within 48 h of ICU admission were independently reviewed by three experts. Lung injury severity was quantified using the CT Severity Score (CT-SS; range 0-25). Patients were categorized as having severe disease (CT-SS ≥ 18) or non-severe disease (CT-SS < 18). The primary outcome was all-cause mortality at 90 days. Secondary outcomes included ICU mortality and medical complications during the ICU stay. Additionally, we evaluated a computer-assisted CT-score assessment using artificial intelligence software (CT Pneumonia Analysis®, SIEMENS Healthcare) to explore the feasibility of automated measurement and routine implementation.
RESULTS: A total of 215 patients with moderate to severe COVID-19 ARDS were included. The median CT-SS at admission was 18/25 [interquartile range, 15-21]. Among them, 120 patients (56%) had a severe CT-SS (≥ 18), while 95 patients (44%) had a non-severe CT-SS (< 18). The 90-day mortality rates were 20.8% for the severe group and 15.8% for the non-severe group (p = 0.35). No significant association was observed between CT-SS severity and patient outcomes.
CONCLUSION: In patients with moderate to severe COVID-19 ARDS, systematic CT assessment of lung parenchymal injury was not a reliable predictor of 90-day mortality or ICU-related complications.

title_zh: 入院時胸腔電腦斷層掃描表現與 COVID-19 相關 ARDS 患者 90 天死亡率的關聯性？
summary_zh: 這項研究回顧了2020年3月至2022年11月入住加護病房的中重度 COVID-19 相關 ARDS 患者的電腦斷層掃描結果。研究人員分析了患者入院48小時內的電腦斷層影像，並使用 CT 嚴重程度評分 (CT-SS) 評估肺部損傷程度。研究發現，CT-SS 評分較高的患者（表示肺部損傷較嚴重）與 90 天死亡率或加護病房相關併發症之間沒有顯著關聯。研究結論認為，對於中重度 COVID-19 相關 ARDS 患者，系統性電腦斷層評估肺部損傷程度並不能可靠地預測 90 天死亡率或加護病房相關併發症。研究也評估了使用AI軟體自動評估CT分數的可行性，但未提供相關結果的詳細資訊。
applications: 疫情期間，醫生可以利用這項研究的結果更謹慎地解讀重症 COVID-19 患者的電腦斷層掃描結果，避免過度依賴掃描結果來預測病人的生死，而是綜合其他臨床指標來判斷。
醫院可以參考這項研究，重新評估是否需要花費大量資源在重症 COVID-19 患者入院時進行詳細的電腦斷層掃描，或許將資源投入到其他更有效的治療方式上。
未來如果又有新的呼吸道傳染病爆發，這項研究提醒我們，即使電腦斷層掃描可以顯示肺部損傷，但單靠掃描結果可能無法準確預測病人的預後，需要更全面地評估病情。

title: Subgrouping autism and ADHD based on structural MRI population modelling centiles.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Autism and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) are two highly heterogeneous neurodevelopmental conditions with variable underlying neurobiology. Imaging studies have yielded varied results, and it is now clear that there is unlikely to be one characteristic neuroanatomical profile of either condition. Parsing this heterogeneity could allow us to identify more homogeneous subgroups, either within or across conditions, which may be more clinically informative. This has been a pivotal goal for neurodevelopmental research using both clinical and neuroanatomical features, though results thus far have again been inconsistent with regards to the number and characteristics of subgroups.
METHODS: Here, we use population modelling to cluster a multi-site dataset based on global and regional centile scores of cortical thickness, surface area and grey matter volume. We use HYDRA, a novel semi-supervised machine learning algorithm which clusters based on differences to controls and compare its performance to a traditional clustering approach.
RESULTS: We identified distinct subgroups within autism and ADHD, as well as across diagnosis, often with opposite neuroanatomical alterations relatively to controls. These subgroups were characterised by different combinations of increased or decreased patterns of morphometrics. We did not find significant clinical differences across subgroups.
LIMITATIONS: Crucially, however, the number of subgroups and their membership differed vastly depending on chosen features and the algorithm used, highlighting the impact and importance of careful method selection.
CONCLUSIONS: We highlight the importance of examining heterogeneity in autism and ADHD and demonstrate that population modelling is a useful tool to study subgrouping in autism and ADHD. We identified subgroups with distinct patterns of alterations relative to controls but note that these results rely heavily on the algorithm used and encourage detailed reporting of methods and features used in future studies.

title_zh: 基於結構性MRI人口建模百分位數的自閉症和注意力不足過動症亞群分析
summary_zh: 這項研究旨在探索自閉症(ASD)和注意力不足過動症(ADHD)這兩種異質性高的神經發展疾病中，是否存在不同的腦部結構亞群。研究人員利用多中心數據集，基於大腦皮層厚度、表面積和灰質體積的人口建模百分位數，使用一種新的半監督機器學習算法HYDRA進行分群，並與傳統分群方法比較。研究發現，在ASD和ADHD內部以及跨診斷之間，都存在不同的亞群，這些亞群表現出相對於控制組不同的腦部結構改變模式。然而，亞群的數量和成員組成很大程度上取決於所選擇的特徵和算法。研究強調了檢視ASD和ADHD異質性的重要性，並證明人口建模是研究亞群的有用工具，同時也提醒未來研究應詳細報告所使用的方法和特徵。
applications: 1. 假設未來醫生可以利用這項研究找到的腦部結構特徵，將自閉症或過動症的孩子分成不同群組，針對不同群組提供更精準的治療方案，就像量身定做一樣，讓治療效果更好。
2. 這項研究發現，自閉症和過動症可能不是單一疾病，而是由好幾種不同的亞型組成。如果能更了解這些亞型的腦部特徵，就能開發出更有效的早期篩檢工具，及早發現、及早介入，幫助孩子們更好地發展。
3. 藥廠可以利用這項研究的發現，針對不同腦部結構特徵的自閉症或過動症亞群，開發更具針對性的藥物。這樣一來，藥物就能更有效地作用在特定患者身上，減少不必要的副作用。

title: Identifying associations of de novo noncoding variants with autism through integration of gene expression, sequence, and sex information.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data has facilitated genome-wide identification of rare noncoding variants. However, elucidating these variants' associations with complex diseases remains challenging. A previous study utilized a deep-learning-based framework and reported a significant brain-related association signal of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) detected from de novo noncoding variants in the Simons Simplex Collection (SSC) WGS cohort.
RESULTS: We revisit the reported significant brain-related ASD association signal attributed to deep-learning and show that local GC content can capture similar association signals. We further show that the association signal appears driven by variants from male proband-female sibling pairs that are upstream of assigned genes. We then develop Expression Neighborhood Sequence Association Study (ENSAS), which utilizes gene expression correlations and sequence information, to more systematically identify phenotype-associated variant sets. Applying ENSAS to the same set of de novo variants, we identify gene expression-based neighborhoods showing significant ASD association signal, enriched for synapse-related gene ontology terms. For these top neighborhoods, we also identify chromatin state annotations of variants that are predictive of the proband-sibling local GC content differences.
CONCLUSIONS: Overall, our work simplifies a previously reported ASD signal and provides new insights into associations of noncoding de novo mutations in ASD. We also present a new analytical framework for understanding disease impact of de novo mutations, applicable to other phenotypes.

title_zh: 整合基因表現、序列與性別資訊，鑑定與自發性非編碼變異相關的自閉症
summary_zh: 本研究重新檢視先前一項關於自閉症譜系障礙（ASD）的研究，該研究聲稱透過深度學習發現了與大腦相關的顯著ASD關聯信號，而該信號來自西蒙斯單純集合（SSC）WGS隊列中的從頭非編碼變異。研究發現，局部GC含量可以捕捉到類似的關聯信號，且該信號主要由男性先證者-女性同胞配對中基因上游的變異驅動。研究人員進一步開發了「表現鄰域序列關聯研究」（ENSAS），利用基因表現相關性和序列資訊，系統性地鑑定與表型相關的變異集合。ENSAS發現，基於基因表現的鄰域顯示出顯著的ASD關聯信號，且富含與突觸相關的基因本體術語。總體而言，這項工作簡化了先前報導的ASD信號，並為理解ASD中非編碼從頭突變的關聯提供了新的見解，同時也為理解從頭突變的疾病影響提供了一個新的分析框架。
applications: 1. 自閉症早期篩檢：透過分析新生兒的基因序列，找出可能增加自閉症風險的非編碼變異，及早介入治療或提供支持。
2. 個性化治療：根據個體的基因表現和變異特徵，了解自閉症的不同亞型，從而制定更精準的治療方案，提高療效。
3. 藥物開發：研究發現的突觸相關基因，可以作為開發新型自閉症治療藥物的靶點，改善患者的社交和溝通能力。

title: Mechanism and application of lactylation in cancers.
summary: Lactate is a crucial product of cancer metabolism, creating an acidic environment that supports cancer growth and acts as a substrate for lactylation. Lactylation, a newly discovered epigenetic modification, plays a vital role in cancer cell signaling, metabolic reprogramming, immune response, and other functions. This review explores the regulation of lactylation, summarizes recent research on its role in cancers, and highlights its application in cancer drug resistance and immunotherapy. These insights aim to provide new avenues for targeting lactylation in cancer therapy.

title_zh: 乳酸化在癌症中的機制與應用
summary_zh: 乳酸是癌細胞代謝的重要產物，它不僅營造出有利於癌細胞生長的酸性環境，也是一種稱為「乳酸化」的化學修飾的原料。乳酸化是一種新發現的表觀遺傳修飾，在癌細胞的訊號傳遞、代謝重塑和免疫反應中扮演關鍵角色。本研究回顧了乳酸化的調控機制，總結了其在各種癌症中的作用，並強調了它在癌症藥物抗藥性和免疫治療中的應用。這些發現有望為癌症治療中靶向乳酸化提供新的途徑。
applications: 想像一下，癌細胞就像一個小工廠，它會產生一種叫做乳酸的廢物。過去我們只知道乳酸會讓腫瘤周圍變酸，幫助癌細胞生長。但現在我們發現，乳酸還可以像「貼標籤」一樣，改變癌細胞的行為。這個研究就是想了解這個「乳酸標籤」是怎麼運作的，如果我們能控制這個標籤，也許就能讓癌細胞停止生長，甚至讓它們更容易被藥物殺死。
這個研究就像是發現了癌細胞的一個新的弱點。癌細胞為了快速生長，會產生大量的乳酸。如果我們能找到方法阻止乳酸的產生，或者阻止乳酸對癌細胞的影響，就能開發出新的抗癌藥物。這就像是找到了對付癌細胞的新武器，有機會提高癌症治療的成功率。
免疫治療是現在很熱門的癌症治療方法，它能幫助我們的免疫系統去攻擊癌細胞。但有些癌細胞會躲避免疫系統的攻擊。這個研究發現，乳酸化可能與癌細胞躲避免疫系統有關。如果我們能了解乳酸化是如何影響免疫反應的，也許就能開發出新的方法，讓免疫治療對更多的癌症患者有效。

title: Effect of single-visit full-mouth non-surgical therapy and risk factor analysis on long-term periodontal treatment outcomes: aretrospective study.
summary:
OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to evaluate the long-term effectiveness of single-visit full-mouth non-surgical therapy in managing patients with progressive periodontitis during supportive periodontal therapy (SPT), with tooth loss due to periodontitis (TLP) as the primary outcome. Secondary objectives included assessing changes in probing depth (PD) and identifying risk factors associated with TLP.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective analysis was conducted using patient records from the University of Michigan School of Dentistry. Included were 283 patients (mean age: 53.2 years) with periodontal breakdown during SPT (PiKS) who underwent single-visit full-mouth ultrasonic instrumentation. The primary outcome was TLP over a mean follow-up of 19.4 years. Secondary outcomes included changes in PD (≥ 5 mm and ≥ 6 mm) and identification of risk factors for tooth loss. Statistical analyses used multilevel binary logistic regression with generalized estimating equations (GEE) and linear regression models.
RESULTS: Among 283 patients (mean age: 53.2 years), the mean TLP was 0.9 teeth per patient over a mean follow-up of 19.4 years. Factors significantly associated with TLP included diabetes (OR = 2.41; p = 0.013), current smoking (OR = 2.13; p = 0.025), higher periodontitis Grades B and C (OR = 3.31; p = 0.001), and Stages III-IV (OR = 8.67; p = 0.001). Baseline pocket depths (PD) ≥ 5 mm (OR = 1.13; p = 0.002) and ≥ 6 mm (OR = 1.29; p = 0.001) were also associated with higher TLP. Each additional annual SPT visit reduced the TLP risk by half (OR = 0.50; p = 0.003). PD ≥ 5 mm showed minimal increase change (0.16; p = 0.02), while depths ≥ 6 mm actually decreased (-0.10; p = 0.01).
CONCLUSION: Single-visit full-mouth non-surgical therapy is effective for long-term management of PiKS, with low tooth loss rates. Diabetes, smoking, advanced periodontitis stage/grade, and deeper baseline pockets are key predictors of TLP. Frequent SPT visits significantly mitigate tooth loss risk.
CLINICAL RELEVANCE: During (SPT) appointments, prevalent practice involves the full-mouth instrumentation of persistent periodontal pockets to disrupt microbial populations and consequently reduce the inflammatory response responsible for disease progression. This study investigates the efficacy of single-visit full-mouth instrumentation as a potential alternative to standard practices in controlling periodontal disease during SPT, which have potential benefits for patients, including reduced treatment time, improved adherence to maintenance therapy, and comprehensive management of periodontal disease. By minimizing the number of visits, this approach may enhance patient compliance while reducing the risk of reinfection from untreated sites between sessions, ultimately contributing to better long-term periodontal stability. Factors such as deeper baseline probing depths and crucial risk elements for TLP-including diabetes, smoking, and advanced stages (III-IV) and grades (B and C) of periodontitis, can play a role in TLP. Additionally, this study provides valuable insights into the customization of more intensive interventions for patients at higher risk. Our findings highlight the importance of frequent SPT visits, with each additional annual visit halving the risk of TLP. The observed reduction in PD of ≥ 6 mm following treatment indicates the significant potential of comprehensive debridement for enhancing long-term periodontal stability. This evidence supports the implementation of tailored, intensive SPT schedules, particularly for patients identified as having higher risks, thereby contributing to improved clinical outcomes in periodontal disease management.

title_zh: 單次全口非手術治療與風險因子分析對牙周病長期治療結果之影響：回溯性研究
summary_zh: 本研究旨在評估單次全口非手術治療在牙周支持性治療(SPT)期間對控制進行性牙周炎患者的長期效果，主要關注因牙周病導致的拔牙(TLP)。研究回顧了283位在SPT期間出現牙周問題的患者，平均追蹤19.4年。結果顯示，單次全口非手術治療能有效控制病情，降低拔牙率。糖尿病、吸菸、較嚴重的牙周病分級(B和C)和分期(III-IV)，以及較深的牙周囊袋是拔牙的重要風險因子。更頻繁的SPT能顯著降低拔牙風險，每年多一次SPT，拔牙風險降低一半。研究證實，對於高風險患者，更頻繁的SPT能改善長期牙周穩定性。
applications: 情境一：王先生有糖尿病和吸菸習慣，最近牙齦常常流血。牙醫可以根據這項研究，建議他除了接受單次全口深層清潔外，更要積極控制血糖、戒菸，並且增加回診洗牙的頻率，才能有效預防牙齒掉落。
情境二：李太太的牙周病比較嚴重，屬於第三期。牙醫可以根據這項研究，告訴李太太她的牙周病風險較高，需要更積極的治療和維護，例如更頻繁的回診檢查和深層清潔，才能維持牙齒的健康。
情境三：某牙醫診所想提升牙周病治療的長期成效。診所可以參考這項研究，針對有糖尿病、吸菸或牙周病較嚴重的患者，提供更個人化的治療計畫，例如增加洗牙頻率，並加強衛教，幫助患者控制風險因子，以提升治療效果。

title: Fibromyalgia: one year in review 2025.
summary: Fibromyalgia (FM) is a chronic syndrome characterised by widespread pain, high prevalence, and a significant impact on quality of life. Despite extensive research, its pathogenesis and treatment remain only partially understood, driving continued investigation throughout 2024. Dysregulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis and sympathetic nervous system has been linked to chronic stress responses and neuroinflammation, with neuroimaging and preclinical studies confirming altered pain and stress processing. Low-grade inflammation and metabolic disturbances, including cytokine imbalance and increased adipose tissue infiltration, further exacerbate symptoms. Alterations in the gut microbiota contribute to immune and emotional dysregulation. MRI studies continue to reveal brain changes that differentiate FM from other chronic pain disorders. Multi-omics approaches, including transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses, show promise as diagnostic biomarkers. Mitochondrial dysfunction also emerges as a key factor, since impaired energy metabolism seems to correlate with symptom severity. From a clinical perspective, recent studies have explored under-recognised aspects of FM, such as sexual and cognitive dysfunction, the role of gender, environmental exposures, and the disease's impact on relationships and family life. The differential diagnosis of FM and long COVID has ignited discussion about potential shared mechanisms. Conversely, residual pain in inflammatory diseases remains insufficiently addressed. Therapeutically, non-pharmacological strategies, particularly physical activity and psychosocial interventions, remain fundamental. Emerging areas such as non-invasive neuromodulation, psychedelic therapies, and the integration of technologies like virtual reality and artificial intelligence are opening new frontiers in treatment, patient care, and research. These advances underscore the multifactorial nature of FM and the need for personalised, interdisciplinary approaches.

title_zh: 纖維肌痛症：2025年度回顧
summary_zh: 纖維肌痛症是一種慢性疾病，主要特徵是全身性的疼痛，且對生活品質影響很大。雖然已經有很多研究，但我們對它的病因和治療方式還不夠了解。研究發現，患者的下視丘-腦垂腺-腎上腺軸功能失調，神經系統也受到影響，導致慢性壓力反應和神經發炎。腦部影像研究顯示，纖維肌痛症患者的大腦處理疼痛和壓力的方式與常人不同。此外，腸道菌群的改變、發炎反應和代謝異常也可能加重病情。目前，多體學分析有潛力成為診斷的生物標記。治療方面，除了運動和心理治療等非藥物方法外，非侵入性神經調節、迷幻藥療法以及虛擬實境和人工智慧等新技術也帶來了新的希望。這些進展都表明，纖維肌痛症是一種多因素疾病，需要個人化的跨領域治療方法。
applications: 假設您長期感到全身疼痛、疲勞，影響工作和生活，但檢查結果都正常，醫生可能會考慮您是否患有纖維肌痛症。這項研究有助於醫生更準確地診斷這種疾病，避免誤診或延誤治療。
如果您已經被診斷出纖維肌痛症，這項研究告訴我們，除了吃藥，運動、心理治療、甚至虛擬實境等新方法，都可以幫助您減輕疼痛、改善生活品質。您可以和醫生討論，選擇最適合您的治療方案。
如果您身邊有親友患有纖維肌痛症，這項研究可以幫助您更了解他們的痛苦，知道這不只是「心理作用」，而是真實存在的生理疾病。您可以給予他們更多的支持和理解，鼓勵他們積極接受治療。

title: Novel bioparameters derived from bioimpedance measurements for accurate prediction of weight status in infant-juvenile individuals: A regression analysis.
summary: In this study, a linear support vector machine regression model was used to explore the correlation between weight status and two novel bioparameters, specific resistance and reactance, in an infant-juvenile cohort from eastern Cuba. The model was trained using various characteristics, including bioimpedance measurements, to predict phase angle, specific resistance, and reactance with high accuracy. The results showed that the variation of these characteristics with weight status and sex is consistent with previous literature. Additionally, two robust bioparameters derived from bioimpedance measurements and anthropometric-physiological parameters were identified for predicting weight status. The predictive models developed in this study are essential for accurately assessing weight status and disease risks in infants and juveniles in the eastern Cuban region. These findings highlight the potential applications of bioimpedance measurements and bioparameters in health and disease risk assessment, contributing to the growing body of literature on this topic.

summary_zh: 本研究利用線性支持向量機迴歸模型，探討古巴東部地區嬰幼兒的體重狀況與兩個新型生物參數（比電阻和比電抗）之間的關聯性。該模型使用生物阻抗量測等多種特徵進行訓練，以高精度預測相位角、比電阻和比電抗。結果顯示，這些特徵隨體重狀況和性別的變化與既有文獻一致。此外，還確定了兩個源自生物阻抗量測和人體測量-生理參數的穩健生物參數，用於預測體重狀況。本研究開發的預測模型對於準確評估古巴東部地區嬰幼兒的體重狀況和疾病風險至關重要。這些發現突顯了生物阻抗量測和生物參數在健康和疾病風險評估中的潛在應用。
applications: 兒童健康篩檢：透過簡單的生物阻抗量測，快速判斷小朋友是否有過重或過輕的風險，及早介入改善飲食和運動習慣。
營養評估工具：幫助營養師更精準地評估嬰幼兒的營養狀況，提供個人化的飲食建議，確保健康成長。

title: Federated prediction for scalable and privacy-preserved knowledge-based planning in radiotherapy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Deep learning has potential to improve the efficiency and consistency of radiation therapy planning, but clinical adoption is hindered by the limited model generalizability due to data scarcity and heterogeneity among institutions. Although aggregating data from different institutions could alleviate this problem, data sharing is a practical challenge due to concerns about patient data privacy and other technical obstacles.
PURPOSE: This work aims to address this dilemma by developing FedKBP+, a comprehensive federated learning (FL) platform for predictive tasks in real-world applications in radiotherapy treatment planning.
METHODS: We implemented a unified communication stack based on Google Remote Procedure Call (gRPC) to support communication between participants whether located on the same workstation or distributed across multiple workstations. In addition to supporting the centralized FL strategies commonly available in existing open-source frameworks, FedKBP+ also provides a fully decentralized FL model where participants directly exchange model weights to each other through Peer-to-Peer communication. We evaluated FedKBP+ on three predictive tasks using scale-attention network (SA-Net) as the predictive model.
CONCLUSIONS: Our results demonstrate that FedKBP+ is highly effective, efficient and robust, showing great potential as a federated learning platform for radiation therapy.

title: Hospital variation in treatment for synchronous metastatic esophageal and gastric cancer: A nationwide population-based study in the Netherlands.
summary: Care for metastatic esophageal (EC) or gastric cancer (GC) includes a large variety of treatment modalities. Data on treatment variation across centers are unknown. This study investigated treatment variation across hospitals and its effect on overall survival (OS) in the Netherlands by conducting a nationwide retrospective cohort study with population-based data from the Netherlands Cancer Registry. Patients diagnosed with synchronous metastatic EC/GC between 2015 and 2022 were included. Multilevel logistic regression assessed treatment patterns according to hospital of diagnosis. OS was analyzed using Cox regression analysis after categorizing hospitals into tertiles based on their adjusted odds (low/medium/high) for systemic treatment (chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy). Among 8406 EC and 3871 GC patients, the proportion receiving systemic treatment varied substantially: 19.8%-69.6% for EC and 15.8%-81.3% for GC across hospitals. Hospital of diagnosis was significantly associated with the adjusted probability of receiving systemic treatment (p < .0001). Ten out of 78 EC (12.8%) and 7 out of 73 (9.6%) GC hospitals had significantly lower systemic treatment probabilities. EC patients with OS ≥4 months diagnosed at hospitals with lower probabilities had significantly worse OS compared to high-probability hospitals (hazard ratios [HR] 0.87 [0.79-0.95] p = .002). GC patients from low-probability hospitals had significantly worse OS than from medium- (HR 0.86 [0.76-0.96], p = .011) or high-probability hospitals (HR 0.73 [0.64-0.82], p < .0001). In conclusion, this study showed substantial hospital variation in treatment for metastatic EC and GC. Hospital of diagnosis was not only associated with the probability of receiving systemic treatment but also OS. This reflects the challenge of ensuring equal healthcare access.

title_zh: 同步轉移性食道癌和胃癌治療的醫院差異：一項荷蘭全國性人口研究
summary_zh: 這項荷蘭全國性研究分析了2015年至2022年間，8406名食道癌和3871名胃癌轉移患者的治療情況。研究發現，不同醫院在全身性治療（化療、標靶治療、免疫治療）的使用比例上存在顯著差異，食道癌的比例從19.8%到69.6%，胃癌則從15.8%到81.3%。診斷醫院不僅影響患者接受全身性治療的可能性，還與整體存活率有關。在全身性治療比例較低的醫院就診的患者，其存活率明顯較差。這顯示了在確保醫療資源均等性方面所面臨的挑戰，突顯了改善治療標準化和提升弱勢醫院治療水平的必要性。
applications: 想像一下，如果你的親友不幸得了食道癌或胃癌，而且已經擴散了，這項研究告訴我們，去哪家醫院看病很重要！有些醫院可能比較積極使用化療、標靶治療這些方法，而這些積極的治療，看起來真的可以幫助病人活更久。
這項研究就像一面鏡子，照出台灣不同醫院在癌症治療上的差異。政府或醫院管理者可以參考這些數據，看看哪些醫院的治療方式比較落後，然後想辦法提升他們的醫療水平，讓每個病人在哪裡都能得到差不多的照顧。
如果你是醫生或護理師，看到這項研究，可以更積極地參與醫院的癌症治療討論，確保病人能得到最適合的治療。同時，也可以多和其他醫院的同事交流，學習他們的經驗，一起提升癌症治療的水平。

title: A Tragic Tale of Mucormycosis and COVID-19: An Observational Study to Identify Predisposing Risk Factors and Outcomes in a Tertiary Care Centre in Central India.
summary: Objective The incidence of mucormycosis, an angioinvasive fungal infection, peaked in India affecting COVID-19 patients. The primary objective of our study was to identify the predisposing risk factors for its development in our country. The secondary objective of our study was to describe the factors affecting the anaesthetic management and the outcome of mucormycosis patients. Methods This was a retrospective observational hospital-based study. All the patients with post-COVID mucormycosis planned for surgical debridement in operation theatre were included. Patients with active COVID infection who tested positive by reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction, those with cerebral involvement and patients admitted for re-debridement surgeries were excluded from the study. Results About 86.6% of patients gave a prior history of COVID infection, while 21.1% did not have any prior history; 77% of patients were diagnosed cases of diabetes, 13% were newly diagnosed and 10% of patients were non-diabetics. About 62.2% of patients gave a positive history of hospitalization whereas 81.1% gave a positive history of use of steroids in some form or the other. Conclusions Among all the risk factors, history of COVID-19, presence of diabetes and use of steroids are the most important risk factors which contributed to the development of mucormycosis.

summary_zh: 這項研究調查了COVID-19患者中毛黴菌病（一種血管侵襲性真菌感染）的風險因素。研究發現，COVID-19感染史、糖尿病和類固醇使用是導致毛黴菌病的最重要風險因素。在研究的患者中，約86.6%有COVID-19感染史，77%患有糖尿病，81.1%曾使用類固醇。這項研究強調了控制糖尿病和謹慎使用類固醇在預防COVID-19相關毛黴菌病中的重要性。對於有這些風險因素的患者，應加強對毛黴菌病的篩檢與早期診斷，以改善治療效果。
applications: 場景一：疫情期間，糖友小明確診新冠，康復後眼睛突然腫脹、視力模糊。如果他知道這項研究，就能警覺可能是毛黴菌感染，及早尋求醫療協助，避免病情惡化。

場景三：政府衛生部門可以根據這項研究結果，針對COVID-19康復者，尤其是糖尿病患者和使用過類固醇的族群，加強毛黴菌病的預防宣導，提高民眾的警覺性。

title: Adherence to the ABC (atrial fibrillation better care) pathway and risk of adverse outcomes in patients with chronic kidney disease: a report from the prospective APHRS-AF registry.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Limited data exist on the effectiveness of the ABC (Atrial Fibrillation Better Care) pathway in reducing adverse events in Asian patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) and chronic kidney disease (CKD).
METHODS: A post-hoc analysis of the prospective APHRS AF Registry. Patients were divided into CKD (eGFR < 60 ml/min) and non-CKD (eGFR ≥ 60 ml/min) groups. Logistic regression assessed factors associated with CKD, oral anticoagulant (OAC) use, and rhythm control strategies. Cox regression estimated hazard ratios (HRs) for a composite outcome of all-cause mortality and major adverse cardiovascular events. Subgroup analyses evaluated outcomes by CKD severity and ABC adherence.
FINDINGS: Of 3550 patients, 1029 had CKD (mean age 75.3 ± 10.3 years, 40.3% female), and 2521 did not (66.4 ± 11.3 years, 32.3% female). CKD patients were older, more often female, had lower ABC adherence (29.5% vs. 42.1%, p < 0.001) and anticoagulation use (Odds Ratio [OR] 0.77, 95% CI 0.61-0.96), but higher warfarin use, and were less likely to receive rhythm control (OR 0.79, 95% CI 0.66-0.94) comparing to those without CKD. CKD and adherence to the ABC pathway were independently associated with higher (HR 1.90, 95% CI 1.46-2.48) and lower (HR 0.64, 95% CI 0.48-0.87) risks of the composite outcome, respectively. Adverse event risks increased with CKD severity, and ABC pathway benefits were observed irrespective of CKD.
INTERPRETATION: AF patients with CKD show lower ABC pathway adherence and high risk of adverse events. Improving adherence to integrated care approaches may improve prognosis in this patient group.
FUNDING: This study was an independent research grant by Pfizer and Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) to APHRS.

title_zh: 遵循ABC（心房顫動優質照護）路徑與慢性腎臟病患者不良預後風險：來自前瞻性APHRS-AF登記研究的報告
summary_zh: 這項研究分析了亞洲心房顫動(AF)合併慢性腎臟病(CKD)患者的照護情況。研究發現，CKD患者較少遵循ABC照護路徑，且發生不良事件的風險更高。ABC照護路徑包含抗凝血治療、控制心律和管理共病。CKD患者較少接受口服抗凝血劑和心律控制，導致全因死亡率和主要心血管不良事件的風險顯著增加。即使有CKD，遵循ABC路徑的患者預後也較佳。因此，加強CKD合併AF患者對ABC照護路徑的遵循，有助於改善他們的健康狀況。

【醫院照護流程優化】：醫院可以根據這項研究結果，檢視並改善心房顫動合併慢性腎臟病患者的照護流程，例如加強對ABC照護路徑的推廣，確保患者獲得適當的抗凝血治療和心律控制。

title: Democratizing biomedical simulation through automated model discovery and a universal material subroutine.
summary: Personalized computational simulations have emerged as a vital tool to understand the biomechanical factors of a disease, predict disease progression, and design personalized intervention. Material modeling is critical for realistic biomedical simulations, and poor model selection can have life-threatening consequences for the patient. However, selecting the best model requires a profound domain knowledge and is limited to a few highly specialized experts in the field. Here we explore the feasibility of eliminating user involvement and automate the process of material modeling in finite element analyses. We leverage recent developments in constitutive neural networks, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to discover the best constitutive model from thousands of possible combinations of a few functional building blocks. We integrate all discoverable models into the finite element workflow by creating a universal material subroutine that contains more than 60,000 models, made up of 16 individual terms. We prototype this workflow using biaxial extension tests from healthy human arteries as input and stress and stretch profiles across the human aortic arch as output. Our results suggest that constitutive neural networks can robustly discover various flavors of arterial models from data, feed these models directly into a finite element simulation, and predict stress and strain profiles that compare favorably to the classical Holzapfel model. Replacing dozens of individual material subroutines by a single universal material subroutine-populated directly via automated model discovery-will make finite element simulations more user-friendly, more robust, and less vulnerable to human error. Democratizing finite element simulation by automating model selection could induce a paradigm shift in physics-based modeling, broaden access to simulation technologies, and empower individuals with varying levels of expertise and diverse backgrounds to actively participate in scientific discovery and push the boundaries of biomedical simulation.

title_zh: 透過自動化模型探索和通用材料子程序實現生物醫學模擬的普及化
summary_zh: 這項研究旨在簡化生物醫學模擬的材料建模過程，讓更多人可以使用。傳統上，選擇合適的材料模型需要專業知識，且容易出錯。研究團隊利用神經網路、機器學習和人工智慧，開發出一種自動化的模型探索方法，可以從數千種可能的組合中找到最佳模型。他們創建了一個包含超過6萬個模型的通用材料子程序，並用人類動脈的測試數據驗證了其有效性。結果顯示，該方法可以準確預測動脈的應力和應變。透過自動化模型選擇，並用單一通用子程序取代多個個別子程序，這項技術能使生物醫學模擬更易用、更可靠，並降低人為錯誤的風險，從而促進生物醫學研究的發展。

研究人員可以快速建立各種組織和器官的精確模型，加速藥物開發過程，例如模擬藥物在腫瘤組織中的擴散和作用效果。
工程師可以利用這項技術設計更安全、更有效的醫療器材，例如人工關節或骨骼植入物，提高病患的生活品質。

title: High throughput assessment of blueberry fruit internal bruising using deep learning models.
summary: The rising costs and labor shortages have sparked interest in machine harvesting of fresh-market blueberries. A major drawback of machine harvesting is the occurrence of internal bruising, as the fruit undergoes multiple mechanical impacts during this process. Evaluating fruit internal bruising manually is a tedious and time-consuming process. In this study, we leveraged deep learning models to rapidly quantify berry fruit internal bruising. Blueberries from 61 cultivars of soft to firm types were subjected to bruise over a three-year period from 2021-2023. Dropped berries were sliced in half along the equator and digitally photographed. The captured images were first analyzed using the YOLO detection model to identify and isolate individual fruits with bounding boxes. Then YOLO segmentation models were performed on each fruit to obtain the fruit cross-section area and the bruising area, respectively. Finally, the bruising ratio was calculated by dividing the predicted bruised area by the predicted cross-sectional area. The mean Average Precision (mAP) of the bruising segmentation model was 0.94. The correlation between the bruising ratio and ground truth was 0.69 with a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 15.87%. Moreover, analysis of bruising ratios of different cultivars revealed significant variability in bruising susceptibility and the mean bruising ratio of 0.22 could be an index to differentiate the bruise-resistant and bruise-susceptible cultivars. Furthermore, the mean bruising ratio was negatively correlated with mechanical texture parameter, Young's modulus 20% Burst Strain. Overall, this study presents an effective and efficient approach with a user-friendly interface to evaluate blueberry internal bruising using deep learning models, which could facilitate the breeding of blueberry genotypes optimized for machine harvesting. The models are available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/c-tan/blueberrybruisingdet.

title_zh: 利用深度學習模型進行藍莓果實內部損傷的高通量評估
summary_zh: 由於人工成本上升和勞動力短缺，機械採收藍莓的需求日益增加。然而，機械採收容易造成藍莓內部損傷。本研究利用深度學習模型快速量化藍莓果實的內部損傷程度。研究人員對61個品種的藍莓進行撞擊測試，並拍攝切半後的藍莓照片。利用YOLO模型辨識藍莓個體，再使用YOLO分割模型計算果實橫截面積和損傷面積，進而計算損傷比例。結果顯示，損傷分割模型的平均精度高達0.94，損傷比例與實際損傷程度的相關性為0.69。研究發現，不同品種的藍莓損傷程度差異顯著，且損傷比例與果實的機械質地參數（楊氏模量）呈負相關。此研究提供了一種有效且高效的方法，可使用深度學習模型評估藍莓內部損傷，有助於選育更適合機械採收的藍莓品種。
applications: 農產品品質檢測：就像醫院用X光檢查人體內部一樣，這項技術可以快速檢查藍莓有沒有內傷，確保消費者吃到高品質的水果。
農業育種：農民可以利用這項技術，快速篩選出不容易碰撞受傷的藍莓品種，讓機械採收的藍莓也能保持好的品質。
食品加工業：食品公司可以利用這項技術，了解藍莓在運輸和加工過程中是否受到損傷，從而改進流程，減少浪費。

title: Prognostic value of serum albumin-creatinine ratio as a biomarker in patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Albumin and creatinine are considered important for understanding patient response to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). However, numerous confounding factors complicate the interpretation of albumin and creatinine alone in clinical practice. This study aims to assess the correlation between survival outcomes and serum-albumin creatinine ratio (sACR) in patients treated with ICIs.
METHODS: This study was conducted on individuals who received at least three doses of ICI between 2018 and 2023. Patients were divided into two groups, sACR-High and sACR-Low, based on the median level. The relationship between sACR and survival outcomes was analyzed using a cox regression model. The relationship between sACR and early progression, late progression, and long-term benefit was analyzed using a logistic regression model.
RESULTS: Patients with lower sACR had decreased overall survival (OS) (HR: 1.42, 95% CI 1.07-1.89, p = 0.014) and progression-free survival (PFS) (HR: 1.34, 95% CI 1.08-1.66, p = 0.009). sACR was associated with early progression (HR: 1.86, 95% CI, 1.14-3.01, p = 0.012), late progression (HR: 2.06, 95 % CI 1.0-4.24, p = 0.050), and long-term benefit of ICIs  (HR: 1.72, 95% CI 1.002-2.93, p = 0.049).
CONCLUSIONS: Our study demonstrated that sACR could serve as an independent predictor of OS, PFS, early progression, late progression, and long-term benefit in patients treated with ICIs.

title_zh: 血清白蛋白肌酸酐比值作為免疫檢查點抑制劑治療患者的預後生物標誌物的價值
summary_zh: 本研究旨在評估血清白蛋白肌酸酐比值(sACR)與接受免疫檢查點抑制劑(ICIs)治療的患者的生存結果之間的關聯性。研究發現，sACR較低的患者，整體存活率(OS)和無惡化存活期(PFS)較差，且與早期惡化、晚期惡化和免疫檢查點抑制劑的長期療效相關。研究結果表明，sACR可以作為ICIs治療患者的OS、PFS、早期惡化、晚期惡化和長期療效的獨立預測因子。這項研究有助於醫生更好地評估患者對免疫治療的反應，並制定更精準的治療方案，從而改善患者的預後。
applications: 情境一：醫生可以透過簡單的血液檢測，計算病患的sACR值，來判斷病患對免疫治療的反應好不好。如果sACR值偏低，醫生可以更密切地監控病患的病情，或考慮調整治療策略。
情境二：藥廠在開發新的免疫治療藥物時，可以將sACR值納入臨床試驗的考量。透過分析不同sACR值的病患對新藥的反應，可以更精準地評估藥物的療效，並找出最適合使用該藥物的族群。
情境三：病患在接受免疫治療前，可以主動詢問醫生關於sACR值的意義。了解自己的sACR值，可以幫助病患更積極地參與治療決策，並對治療結果有更合理的期待。

title: Hypertriglyceridemia-Induced Acute Pancreatitis with Lipemic Samples in a Type 2 Diabetic Patient: A Case Report in a Resource-Limited Setting.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Hypertriglyceridemia (HTG) is a known but relatively uncommon cause of acute pancreatitis (AP), accounting for approximately 1-7% of cases. Hypertriglyceridemia-induced acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) can lead to significant morbidity if not promptly identified and managed. This case report describes a patient with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) who presented with HTG-AP, characterized by a lipemic blood sample, in a resource-limited setting.
CASE PRESENTATION: A 45-year-old male with a history of poorly controlled T2DM and hyperlipidemia presented with a 24-hour history of severe epigastric abdominal pain, fatigue, and vomiting. Clinical examination revealed diffuse abdominal tenderness, tachypnea, tachycardia, and a habitus consistent with central obesity. His BMI was 33.2 kg/m². Initial laboratory findings included seriously elevated triglycerides (1509 mg/dL), lipase (83 U/L), and amylase (161 U/L), along with hyperglycemia (465mg/dL). Abdominal computed tomography (CT) scan showed peripancreatic fatty stranding, consistent with early acute pancreatitis, as well as a fatty liver and a focal hypodense lesion in the right lobe. Treatment included intravenous insulin, dextrose, and potassium infusions to reduce triglyceride levels, analgesics, intravenous fluids for electrolyte imbalances, and thromboprophylaxis with enoxaparin.
CONCLUSION: This case highlights the importance of early recognition of HTG-AP in patients with poorly controlled diabetes and hyperlipidemia. Prompt triglyceride-lowering therapy, primarily with insulin in resource-limited settings, is crucial for improving patient outcomes and preventing complications.

title_zh: 高三酸甘油酯血症引發的急性胰臟炎合併乳糜血檢體：一例第二型糖尿病患者在資源有限環境下的病例報告
summary_zh: 本病例報告描述了一位患有控制不良的第二型糖尿病的45歲男性，因高三酸甘油酯血症引發急性胰臟炎（HTG-AP）就診，其血液樣本呈現乳糜狀。患者有嚴重上腹痛、疲勞和嘔吐等症狀，檢查發現三酸甘油酯顯著升高（1509 mg/dL）。電腦斷層掃描顯示胰臟周圍脂肪浸潤，符合早期急性胰臟炎的表現。治療包括靜脈注射胰島素以降低三酸甘油酯水平。此案例強調了早期識別HTG-AP的重要性，特別是在糖尿病控制不良和高血脂的患者中。在資源有限的環境下，迅速使用胰島素降低三酸甘油酯對於改善患者預後和預防併發症至關重要。
applications: 健康檢查提醒：以後健檢報告如果看到三酸甘油酯過高，就要特別注意飲食和生活習慣，控制血糖，避免引發嚴重的胰臟炎。
糖尿病患者警訊：如果你是糖尿病患者，而且血糖控制不好，就要小心高三酸甘油酯血症，如果有肚子痛的症狀，要趕快就醫檢查。
基層醫療重要性：即使在醫療資源比較缺乏的地方，醫生也要能夠快速判斷這種因為高三酸甘油酯引起的胰臟炎，及時用胰島素治療，才能救人一命。

title: Efficiency and Quality of Generative AI-Assisted Radiograph Reporting.
summary:
IMPORTANCE: Diagnostic imaging interpretation involves distilling multimodal clinical information into text form, a task well-suited to augmentation by generative artificial intelligence (AI). However, to our knowledge, impacts of AI-based draft radiological reporting remain unstudied in clinical settings.
OBJECTIVE: To prospectively evaluate the association of radiologist use of a workflow-integrated generative model capable of providing draft radiological reports for plain radiographs across a tertiary health care system with documentation efficiency, the clinical accuracy and textual quality of final radiologist reports, and the model's potential for detecting unexpected, clinically significant pneumothorax.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This prospective cohort study was conducted from November 15, 2023, to April 24, 2024, at a tertiary care academic health system. The association between use of the generative model and radiologist documentation efficiency was evaluated for radiographs documented with model assistance compared with a baseline set of radiographs without model use, matched by study type (chest or nonchest). Peer review was performed on model-assisted interpretations. Flagging of pneumothorax requiring intervention was performed on radiographs prospectively.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcomes were association of use of the generative model with radiologist documentation efficiency, assessed by difference in documentation time with and without model use using a linear mixed-effects model; for peer review of model-assisted reports, the difference in Likert-scale ratings using a cumulative-link mixed model; and for flagging pneumothorax requiring intervention, sensitivity and specificity.
RESULTS: A total of 23 960 radiographs (11 980 each with and without model use) were used to analyze documentation efficiency. Interpretations with model assistance (mean [SE], 159.8 [27.0] seconds) were faster than the baseline set of those without (mean [SE], 189.2 [36.2] seconds) (P = .02), representing a 15.5% documentation efficiency increase. Peer review of 800 studies showed no difference in clinical accuracy (χ2 = 0.68; P = .41) or textual quality (χ2 = 3.62; P = .06) between model-assisted interpretations and nonmodel interpretations. Moreover, the model flagged studies containing a clinically significant, unexpected pneumothorax with a sensitivity of 72.7% and specificity of 99.9% among 97 651 studies screened.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this prospective cohort study of clinical use of a generative model for draft radiological reporting, model use was associated with improved radiologist documentation efficiency while maintaining clinical quality and demonstrated potential to detect studies containing a pneumothorax requiring immediate intervention. This study suggests the potential for radiologist and generative AI collaboration to improve clinical care delivery.

title_zh: 生成式人工智慧輔助放射線報告的效率與品質
summary_zh: 這項研究評估了生成式AI在放射線報告中的應用。研究發現，AI輔助可以顯著提升放射科醫師的報告效率，平均縮短15.5%的報告時間。在臨床準確性和文本品質方面，AI輔助報告與傳統報告沒有顯著差異。更重要的是，AI模型在篩檢近十萬張X光片中，能以72.7%的敏感度和99.9%的特異度，成功檢測出需要立即處理的氣胸。這表示AI不僅能幫助醫生更快完成報告，還能輔助診斷，及早發現潛在的危急狀況。研究結果表明，放射科醫師與生成式AI的協作，有潛力改善臨床醫療服務。
applications: 想像一下，以後照X光的速度會更快，因為AI能幫醫生先打一份報告草稿，醫生再檢查一下就好，這樣大家就能更快知道結果，不用在那邊等老半天。
如果AI能幫忙抓出X光片裡比較不明顯的病灶，就像氣胸這種緊急狀況，就能及早發現，及早治療，救人一命。
AI可以減少醫生寫報告的時間，讓他們有更多時間跟病人解釋病情，或是研究更複雜的病例，提升整體醫療品質。

title: Reappraising machine learning models for vascular calcification in CKD: methodological concerns and clinical gaps.
summary: Lin et al. (Int Urol Nephrol, 2025) contribute to the literature on abdominal aortic calcification (AAC) in chronic kidney disease (CKD) using interpretable machine learning. However, several limitations hinder its clinical applicability. The cross-sectional design restricts causal inference, while the lack of external validation limits generalizability. Critical confounders such as pharmacologic interventions and lifestyle factors are omitted, risking bias in the model. In addition, treating CKD as a binary variable oversimplifies its complexity. Despite the promising use of SHAP analysis, the study lacks clinical translation for actionable risk stratification and personalized treatment. Future research should address these gaps to enhance the model's clinical utility.

title_zh: 重新評估機器學習模型於慢性腎臟病血管鈣化之應用：方法學考量與臨床缺口
summary_zh: 這篇研究利用機器學習來預測慢性腎臟病患者的腹主動脈鈣化程度。雖然研究使用了可解釋的機器學習方法，但仍存在一些限制。首先，研究是橫斷面的，無法確定因果關係。其次，缺乏外部驗證，結果可能不適用於所有慢性腎臟病患者。此外，研究忽略了藥物治療和生活方式等重要因素，可能導致模型產生偏差。將慢性腎臟病簡化為二元變量也忽略了其複雜性。儘管研究使用了SHAP分析，但缺乏臨床應用，無法提供可操作的風險分層和個人化治療。未來的研究應解決這些問題，以提高模型的臨床實用性。總之，目前這項研究還需要更多驗證才能真正應用於臨床。
applications: 預測慢性腎臟病患者血管鈣化風險：透過機器學習模型，醫生可以更準確地預測哪些慢性腎臟病患者有較高的血管鈣化風險，及早採取預防措施，例如調整飲食或使用藥物。
個人化治療方案：了解影響血管鈣化的關鍵因素後，醫生可以為每位患者量身定制治療方案，例如針對特定生活習慣或藥物使用進行調整，以減緩血管鈣化的進程。
輔助臨床決策：這個模型可以作為醫生診斷的輔助工具，幫助醫生更全面地評估患者的病情，並做出更明智的治療決策。例如，模型可以提醒醫生注意某些可能被忽略的風險因素。

title: Hymenaea courbaril hydroalcoholic extract protects in vivo against oxidative stress in Caenorhabditis elegans via DAF-2 and SKN-1.
summary: Hymenaea courbaril L. (H. courbaril) is a South American native species frequently used to treat various symptoms and illnesses, including anemia, fatigue, inflammation, pain, respiratory conditions, kidney and prostate disorders, cancer, diabetes, arthritis, rheumatism, gastric and hepatic dysfunctions, and skin conditions. This study aimed to examine the in vivo toxicity attributed to H. courbaril stem bark hydroalcoholic extract and its effects on physiological conditions and stress responses. Different strains of Caenorhabditis elegans (C. elegans) were employed. The LC50 of H. courbaril extract in N2 wild-type (L4) worms was 15,076.99 ± 1,66 µg/ml. The extract reduced survival to 92.96% at the highest concentration tested (1600 μg/ml; 24 hr), and after 72 hr treatment, concentrations of 800 or 1600 μg/ml decreased survival to 84.7% and 82.8%, respectively. Body development of C. elegans was also affected by higher concentrations, where only 1600 μg/ml diminished reproduction by 87.88%. Exposure to heat stress reduced C. elegans survival in a time-dependent manner. Also, protected worms against oxidative damage induced by hydrogen peroxide (H2O2,) at different concentrations and times and decreased expression of superoxide dismutase-3(SOD-3)(800 μg/ml; 1600 μg/ml), glutathione-S-transferase-4 (GST-4) (800 μg/ml), and cytotoxic T lymphocytes (CTL)-1/2/3) (400; 800 μg/ml), suggesting that protection may involve modulation of the decay-accelerating factor-2 (DAF-2) and SKN-1 transcription factor pathways. In conclusion, H. courbaril extract exhibited a low toxicity profile at the concentrations tested and under the conditions used in the study. The extract may serve as a potential antioxidant and stress-protective agent associated with modulation DAF-2 and SKN-1 pathway.

title_zh: 紅皮膠木水醇萃取物透過DAF-2與SKN-1途徑保護秀麗隱桿線蟲免受體內氧化壓力
summary_zh: 本研究探討南美原生植物紅皮膠木萃取物對秀麗隱桿線蟲的影響。研究發現，在一定濃度下，紅皮膠木萃取物對線蟲的毒性較低，並能保護線蟲免受氧化壓力的損害。這種保護作用可能與DAF-2和SKN-1這兩個重要的調控途徑有關，這兩個途徑在生物體的抗壓和延緩衰老過程中扮演關鍵角色。研究結果表明，紅皮膠木萃取物具有潛力作為一種抗氧化劑和壓力保護劑，未來或許可開發成保健食品，以增強人體對抗氧化壓力的能力，並促進健康老化。
applications: 如果家裡長輩容易疲勞，或是想維持身體機能，或許可以考慮紅皮膠木萃取物的保健食品，幫助他們對抗氧化壓力，更有活力。
現代人生活壓力大，容易產生自由基，加速老化。紅皮膠木萃取物可能可以作為日常保健的一環，幫助我們抵抗氧化，維持年輕。
針對需要長時間曝曬在陽光下，或是工作環境容易接觸到有害物質的人，紅皮膠木萃取物或許能提供額外的保護，降低氧化壓力對身體的傷害。

title: OSAM-NET: A multi-feature fusion model for measuring fetal head flexion during labor with transformer multi-head self-attention.
summary: Fetal head flexion is essential during labor. The current assessment presents technical challenges for unskilled ultrasound operators. Therefore, the study aimed to propose an occiput-spine angle measurement network (OSAM-NET) to improve the accuracy and intrapartum applicability of fetal head flexion assessment. We used YOLOv8 to extract key anatomical structures (occiput and spine) and Vision Transformer to extract global features on ultrasound images of the posterior mid-sagittal section of the fetus (PMSF). Then, by fusing the geometric location information and global features through the multi-head self-attention mechanism, we constructed the multi-feature fusion model OSAM-NET. The model was able to extract intricate features from multi-dimensional information, effectively boosting the accuracy of occiput-spine angle (OSA) prediction. We curated the first OSA dataset comprising 1688 high-quality, clear PMSF ultrasound images and annotations to train and test our model. We evaluated the performance of OSAM-NET and compared it with other models. The results showed that OSAM-NET outperformed the comparison models on all evaluation metrics, with R² increasing by nearly 13 %, and root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) decreasing by approximately 15 % and 20 %, respectively. The intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) improved by about 8 %, with the average value reaching 0.89, indicating good agreement with the measurements of ultrasound experts. The multi-feature fusion model OSAM-NET demonstrates strong applicability and predictive accuracy for complex ultrasound images. This study provides a reliable and efficient tool for automatically evaluating fetal head flexion. The real-world application potential has been validated on prospective test dataset.

title_zh: OSAM-NET：基於Transformer多頭自注意力機制的多特徵融合模型，用於測量分娩期間的胎兒頭部俯屈
summary_zh: 胎兒頭部俯屈在分娩過程中至關重要。目前，對於不熟練的超音波操作者來說，評估胎兒頭部俯屈存在技術挑戰。本研究提出了一種枕骨-脊椎角度測量網路（OSAM-NET），旨在提高胎兒頭部俯屈評估的準確性和分娩時的適用性。該模型利用YOLOv8提取關鍵解剖結構（枕骨和脊椎），並使用Vision Transformer提取胎兒後正中矢狀切面(PMSF)超音波圖像的全局特徵。然後，通過多頭自注意力機制融合幾何位置訊息和全局特徵，構建多特徵融合模型OSAM-NET。實驗結果表明，OSAM-NET在所有評估指標上均優於其他模型，並且與超音波專家的測量結果具有良好的一致性。OSAM-NET具有很強的適用性和預測準確性，為自動評估胎兒頭部俯屈提供了一種可靠且高效的工具。
applications: 想像一下，以後孕婦在生產時，醫生可以透過AI超音波系統，更精準地判斷胎兒頭部的位置，就像幫胎兒導航一樣，讓生產過程更順利，降低難產的風險。
這項技術就像是幫超音波機器裝上了更聰明的大腦，即使是經驗比較少的醫生，也能更準確地讀懂超音波影像，減少誤判，讓孕婦得到更好的照顧。
未來，這套系統甚至可以應用在遠端醫療上，讓偏鄉地區的孕婦也能享受到高品質的產檢服務，不用長途跋涉到大醫院，非常方便。

title: Unpaired multi-modal training and single-modal testing for detecting signs of endometriosis.
summary: Endometriosis is a serious multifocal condition that can involve various pelvic structures, with Pouch of Douglas (POD) obliteration being a significant clinical indicator for diagnosis. To circumvent the need for invasive diagnostic procedures like laparoscopy, research has increasingly focused on imaging-based methods such as transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). The limited diagnostic accuracy achieved through manual interpretation of these imaging techniques has driven the development of automated classifiers that can effectively utilize both modalities. However, patients often undergo only one of these two examinations, resulting in unpaired data for training and testing POD obliteration classifiers, where TVUS models tend to be more accurate than MRI models, but TVUS scanning are more operator dependent. This prompts a crucial question: Can a model be trained with unpaired TVUS and MRI data to enhance the performance of a model exclusively trained with MRI, while maintaining the high accuracy of the model individually trained with TVUS? In this paper we aim to answer this question by proposing a novel multi-modal POD obliteration classifier that is trained with unpaired TVUS and MRI data and tested using either MRI or TVUS data. Our method is the first POD obliteration classifier that can flexibly take either the TVUS or MRI data, where the model automatically focuses on the uterus region within MRI data, eliminating the need for any manual intervention. Experiments conducted on our endometriosis dataset show that our method significantly improves POD obliteration classification accuracy using MRI from AUC=0.4755 (single-modal training and testing, without automatically focusing on the uterus region) to 0.8023 (unpaired multi-modal training and single modality MRI testing, with automatic uterus region detection), while maintaining the accuracy using TVUS with AUC=0.8921 (single modality TVUS testing using either an unpaired multi-modal training or a single-modality training).

title_zh: 非配對多模態訓練與單模態測試用於偵測子宮內膜異位症跡象
summary_zh: 子宮內膜異位症是一種複雜的疾病，道格拉斯窩閉鎖是重要的診斷指標。為避免侵入性手術，研究轉向超音波和核磁共振等影像方法。然而，單獨判讀的準確性有限。本研究提出一種新的多模態分類器，利用非配對的超音波和核磁共振數據進行訓練，並分別使用核磁共振或超音波數據進行測試。此模型能自動聚焦於核磁共振影像中的子宮區域，無需人工干預。實驗結果顯示，該方法顯著提高了核磁共振的診斷準確性，從AUC=0.4755提升至0.8023，同時保持了超音波的準確性（AUC=0.8921）。這項技術有助於提升子宮內膜異位症的非侵入性診斷效率和準確性。
applications: 想像一下，未來女性做健康檢查時，不需要再承受侵入性檢查的痛苦，只要透過超音波或核磁共振，就能更準確地判斷是否有子宮內膜異位症的風險。
這項技術就像幫醫生配備了一個更厲害的AI助手，它可以自動分析複雜的影像資料，找出肉眼難以發現的病灶，讓診斷更快速、更精準。
對於醫療資源有限的地區，這套系統可以利用現有的超音波或核磁共振設備，大幅提升子宮內膜異位症的篩檢效率，讓更多女性受益。

title: A segmentation network based on CNNs for identifying laryngeal structures in video laryngoscope images.
summary: Video laryngoscopes have become increasingly vital in tracheal intubation, providing clear imaging that significantly improves success rates, especially for less experienced clinicians. However, accurate recognition of laryngeal structures remains challenging, which is critical for successful first-attempt intubation in emergency situations. This paper presents MPE-UNet, a deep learning model designed for precise segmentation of laryngeal structures from video laryngoscope images, aiming to assist clinicians in performing tracheal intubation more accurately and efficiently. MPE-UNet follows the classic U-Net architecture, which features an encoder-decoder structure and enhances it with advanced modules and innovative techniques at every stage. In the encoder, we designed an improved multi-scale feature extraction module, which better processes complex throat images. Additionally, a pyramid fusion attention module was incorporated into the skip connections, enhancing the model's ability to capture details by dynamically weighting and merging features from different levels. Moreover, a plug-and-play attention mechanism module was integrated into the decoder, further refining the segmentation process by focusing on important features. The experimental results show that the performance of the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

title_zh: 基於卷積神經網路的分割網路，用於識別影像喉鏡圖像中的喉部結構
summary_zh: 本研究提出一種名為MPE-UNet的深度學習模型，旨在精確分割影像喉鏡圖像中的喉部結構，以協助臨床醫生更準確、高效地進行氣管插管。MPE-UNet基於經典的U-Net架構，並在編碼器、跳躍連接和解碼器中加入了改進的多尺度特徵提取模組、金字塔融合注意力模組和可插拔的注意力機制模組，增強了模型捕捉細節和關注重要特徵的能力。實驗結果表明，該方法的性能優於目前最先進的方法，有助於提高氣管插管的成功率，尤其是在緊急情況下。
applications: 急診室醫生可以使用這個AI模型，快速辨識喉部結構，提高緊急插管的成功率，搶救更多生命。
新手醫生可以透過這個AI系統的輔助，更精準地學習插管技巧，縮短訓練時間，減少病患的不適。
這個技術可以應用在遠程醫療上，即使是經驗不足的醫生，也能在AI的協助下，為偏遠地區的病患提供高品質的插管服務。

title: Neophytadiene: Biological activities and drug development prospects.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Neophytadiene (NPT) [C20H38] or 7, 11, 15-Trimethyl-3-methylenehexadec-1-ene is a diterpene found in the important oil of various plants, including neem (Azadirachta indica). It possesses inhibitory properties against a range of enzymes. The prospective uses of neophytadiene in cosmetics, medicine, and agriculture have attracted much interest. Numerous pharmaceutical applications have been demonstrated, such as analgesic, anti-oxidant, anti-microbial, anti-cancer, anti-malarial, insecticidal, and neuroprotective properties. The extraction, purification, and biological uses of neophytadiene have received special attention. Drugs based on phytocompounds are being developed to create affordable treatments with minimal side effects and a wide range of therapeutic uses.
PURPOSE: An overview of the function of neophytadiene is given in this article, along with information on its biological application, pharmacological significance, clinical uses, and its safety concerns.
METHODS: A systematic literature review has been conducted using the PRISMA flow technique. Data for the literature survey was gathered online from various journals, computational databases, and search engines like Scopus, PubMed, Science Direct, and Google Scholar until March 2025.
RESULTS: The biological efficiency of neophytadiene was affirmed using several in vitro and animal model approaches. The efficacy, therapeutic utility and mechanism of neophytadiene against a range of disorders have all been attempted to be assessed. Neophytadiene plays an important role in the anti-inflammation pathway by TLR4 activation and neuroprotective role by PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. Notably, neophytadiene has shown efficacy against a wide range of organisms, including the malaria parasites. This molecule has multiple uses that can help reduce the severity of certain diseases. It also has the potential to be used as a pharmaceutical ingredient. To maximize its advantages, future research will examine the combined effects of neophytadiene with those of other medications and naturally occurring substances. The acceptance of these phytocompounds as potential medications is clarified by elaborating on their pharmacological safety dosages and various stages of clinical testing.
CONCLUSION: According to the reviewed studies, neophytadiene can be used as a medication candidate for treating diseases. However, these agents are used in therapeutic settings, so more clinical and experimental research is required in the future.

title_zh: 新植烷二烯：生物活性與藥物開發前景
summary_zh: 新植烷二烯 (Neophytadiene, NPT) 是一種存在於多種植物中的二萜類化合物，例如印楝。研究顯示，它具有多種生物活性，包括止痛、抗氧化、抗菌、抗癌、抗瘧疾、殺蟲和神經保護等特性。本研究回顧了NPT的功能、生物應用、藥理意義、臨床用途和安全性。結果表明，NPT在體外和動物模型中都顯示出生物學效力，並可能通過TLR4激活途徑發揮抗炎作用，通過PI3K/Akt信號通路發揮神經保護作用。未來的研究將探索NPT與其他藥物或天然物質的聯合效應，以最大限度地發揮其優勢，並進一步驗證其作為潛在藥物的可行性，從而開發出更安全、有效的治療方法。
applications: 想像一下，如果開發出一種天然的蚊蟲驅避劑，不含DEET等化學物質，而是從植物中提取的NPT，這樣對環境更友善，對人體也更安全，特別是對於兒童和孕婦。
如果有一種藥物，可以同時緩解疼痛、抵抗發炎，並且還具有抗氧化的作用，就像NPT一樣，那對於關節炎患者來說，就能夠減少他們需要服用的藥物種類，降低副作用的風險。
如果NPT能夠作為一種輔助治療手段，幫助對抗瘧疾，特別是在那些對傳統藥物產生抗藥性的地區，就能夠挽救更多生命，並且降低疾病的傳播。

title: Connections Among Daily Occupational Participation, Diabetes Self-Management, and Quality of Life.
summary:
IMPORTANCE: Diabetes requires daily management activities, collectively called diabetes self-management (DSM). However, performing DSM while engaging in daily occupations can be challenging to sustain.
OBJECTIVE: To explore the relationships among participating in daily occupations, performing DSM, maintaining target glycemic levels, and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and which daily occupations (domestic, leisure, caring for others, learning, sport, self-care, quiet, spiritual, work activities) explain variations in DSM levels.
DESIGN AND PARTICIPANTS: This cross-sectional study included people with Type 2 diabetes mellitus (N = 99, M age = 65.61 yr, SD = 12.17; glycated hemoglobin [HbA1c] M = 7.98, SD = 1.89; 55.6% male) who received ongoing follow-up in a public health care diabetes clinic in Israel.
MEASURES: Participants completed the DSM, Adult Subjective Assessment of Participation, 12-item Short-Form Health Survey, and demographic questionnaires. HbA1c, fasting glucose, and body mass index information were retrieved from medical charts.
RESULTS: Participation in recreation and leisure activities and total participation correlated with engaging in more physical activities as part of DSM and better mental and physical HRQoL. Domestic activities, caring for others, quiet activities, and work had ambivalent connections with DSM and HRQoL. Participants who engaged in more physical activities accomplished more DSM tasks; those who engaged in quiet activities (e.g., reading, watching TV) completed fewer tasks.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Occupational therapy treatment should be personalized to identify and address specific activities within an individual's daily routine that support or hinder their DSM. Treatment should encourage clients to engage in fewer quiet activities and more physical activities to promote DSM. Plain-Language Summary: Diabetes is a common and complex health condition that requires daily management. Research shows that performing diabetes management activities, called diabetes self-management (DSM), can be challenging and difficult to sustain for many people with diabetes. Our study explored how engaging in daily activities affects DSM, including maintaining glycemic levels and health-related quality of life, for people living with Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), and which activities might help the most. We gathered information from medical records and questionnaires completed by 99 people with T2DM (55 men and 44 women who were, on average, 65 years old). Their average blood glucose levels were above the levels recommended by the American Diabetes Association. We found that participating in daily activities as a whole and engaging in specific activities, such as caring for others and active recreation, were associated with better health-related quality of life and increased engagement in the physical activity component of DSM. However, quieter activities, like reading or watching TV, were associated with decreased engagement in DSM activities. We recommend that occupational therapists work closely with people with T2DM to understand their daily routines and help them positively incorporate activities related to DSM.

title_zh: 日常職能參與、糖尿病自我管理與生活品質之間的關聯
summary_zh: 這項研究探討了第二型糖尿病患者參與日常活動與糖尿病自我管理（DSM）及生活品質之間的關係。研究對象為99位以色列的第二型糖尿病患者，透過問卷和醫療紀錄收集數據，發現參與休閒娛樂活動與更好的身心健康生活品質，以及更多的身體活動相關。從事家務、照顧他人、安靜活動和工作與DSM和生活品質的關聯較不明顯。研究顯示，多從事身體活動的人能更好地完成DSM任務，而從事較多靜態活動（如閱讀、看電視）的人則較少完成任務。因此，職能治療應個人化，找出支持或阻礙DSM的特定活動，並鼓勵患者減少靜態活動，增加身體活動，以促進DSM。
applications: 想像一下，醫院的職能治療師可以根據這項研究，為糖尿病患者設計個人化的運動和活動計畫，鼓勵他們多做喜歡的運動，像是跳舞、園藝，而不是整天躺在沙發上看電視，幫助他們更好地控制血糖。
健康管理App可以結合這項研究的結果，提醒糖尿病患者每天安排一些身體活動，例如散步、做家事，並提供相關的運動建議和追蹤功能，讓他們更容易將自我管理融入日常生活中。
社區健康中心可以舉辦針對糖尿病患者的活動團體，鼓勵大家一起參與戶外運動、烹飪課程等，讓他們在社交互動中學習自我管理技巧，並互相支持，提升生活品質。

title: Comparing models and experimental structures of the GPR101 receptor: Artificial intelligence yields highly accurate models.
summary: Experimental structures solved through cryo-electron microscopy have recently been published for GPR101, a G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) implicated in the genetic condition X-linked acrogigantism (X-LAG). Here, we compared these experimental structures with computational models that we previously published, including our internally developed homology models and third-party models generated through the AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold-Multistate artificial intelligence (AI) methods. Our analysis revealed considerable accuracy for both homology models and AI-generated models. However, it also revealed the general superiority of AI methods. Particularly noteworthy is the model generated by AlphaFold2, which captured with high fidelity various structural aspects, including the challenging second extracellular loop. Our previously published homology model of the GPR101-Gs protein complex, based on the β2-adrenergic receptor, accurately predicted the binding mode of the G protein to the receptor. Moreover, this model predicted the structure of the sixth transmembrane domain (TM6) significantly more accurately than the others, including those built through AI methods, suggesting that homology modeling based on templates solved in complex with the G protein of interest might be the most reliable way of modeling this transmembrane domain. Lastly, our analysis revealed that our molecular dynamics simulations did not have a significant and consistent effect on the accuracy of the models, increasing the accuracy for some domains while decreasing it for others. This work provides insights into the relative strengths of different modeling approaches for our case study on GPR101. More broadly, when considered alongside other assessment studies, it contributes to the growing body of knowledge that can guide the modeling of GPCRs for which experimental structures are not yet available.

title_zh: GPR101受體的模型與實驗結構比較：人工智慧產生高度精確的模型
summary_zh: 科學家們最近利用冷凍電子顯微鏡解析了GPR101受體的結構，這個受體與X染色體相關的肢端肥大症(X-LAG)有關。我們比較了這些實驗結構與我們之前發表的計算模型，包括我們自己建立的同源模型，以及AlphaFold2和AlphaFold-Multistate人工智慧(AI)方法產生的模型。分析顯示，同源模型和AI模型都相當準確，但AI方法總體上更勝一籌。AlphaFold2產生的模型尤其出色，它高度精確地捕捉了各種結構特徵，包括具有挑戰性的第二個細胞外環。我們之前發表的基於β2-腎上腺素受體的GPR101-Gs蛋白複合物同源模型，準確地預測了G蛋白與受體的結合模式。此外，該模型對第六個跨膜結構域(TM6)的結構預測比其他模型（包括AI模型）更準確。分子動力學模擬對模型的準確性沒有顯著且一致的影響。這項研究深入了解了不同建模方法在GPR101案例研究中的相對優勢，並有助於指導尚未獲得實驗結構的GPCR的建模。
applications: 1. 藥物開發加速器：假設某藥廠想開發治療肢端肥大症的新藥，這項研究可以幫助他們更快、更準確地建立GPR101受體的模型，從而加速藥物篩選和設計的過程，就像是為藥廠提供了一個更精準的導航系統。
2. 個人化醫療的基石：如果未來能透過基因檢測得知某人GPR101受體的結構略有不同，這項研究提供的AI建模方法，就能幫助醫生更準確地預測特定藥物對這個人的效果，實現更精準的個人化治療，就像是量身定做的藥物。
3. 解開疾病謎團的鑰匙：GPR101受體與肢端肥大症有關，但其作用機制尚未完全清楚。這項研究提供的精確模型，能幫助科學家更深入地了解受體的功能，進而解開疾病的發病原因，就像是拼圖遊戲中關鍵的一塊。

title: MlCOFSyn: A Machine Learning Framework To Facilitate the Synthesis of 2D Covalent Organic Frameworks.
summary: Two-dimensional covalent organic frameworks (2D COFs) have been historically synthesized empirically, often resulting in uncontrolled crystallization and inferior crystal sizes, which limit their performance in various applications. Recently, crystallization models tailored for 2D COFs have been developed that demonstrate great potential in facilitating their rational synthesis. Nevertheless, effective strategies to leverage these models for 2D COF synthesis remain underdeveloped, and the specialized expertise required, combined with the high computational costs of exploring the vast chemical space, poses additional barriers to their practical application. In this work, we present a machine learning framework, named MlCOFSyn, that is designed to assist in the synthesis of 2D COFs. This framework explores the application of 2D COF crystallization models by implementing three pivotal functionalities: predicting crystal sizes based on the input monomer addition sequence, reverse-engineering monomer addition sequences to achieve desired crystal sizes, and optimizing monomer addition sequences to produce larger crystals. These functionalities are critical for the controlled synthesis of 2D COFs but have been largely underexplored due to the lack of accessible theoretical tools. The MlCOFSyn framework leverages efficient machine-learning algorithms and features an intuitive graphical interface, enabling its use on consumer-grade computers by nonexperts. By addressing these gaps, the MlCOFSyn framework represents a substantial advancement in facilitating 2D COF research and synthesis.

title_zh: MlCOFSyn：一個用於促進二維共價有機骨架合成的機器學習框架
summary_zh: 二維共價有機骨架(2D COFs)的合成一直以來都依賴經驗，導致結晶控制不佳和晶體尺寸較小，限制了其應用。本研究提出一個名為MlCOFSyn的機器學習框架，旨在輔助2D COFs的合成。該框架具有三項關鍵功能：預測基於單體添加順序的晶體尺寸、逆向工程單體添加順序以實現所需的晶體尺寸，以及優化單體添加順序以產生更大的晶體。MlCOFSyn利用高效的機器學習算法和直觀的圖形界面，使非專業人員也能在一般電腦上使用。MlCOFSyn框架的出現，對於促進2D COFs的研究和合成是一大進步。
applications: 想像一下，我們可以用這個AI工具，更精準地設計出更好的濾水材料，讓大家喝到更乾淨的水，就像客製化濾網一樣。
這個技術可以幫助開發更高效的太陽能板，讓太陽能發電更普及，就像幫太陽能板量身打造最佳結構。
未來的藥物傳輸系統，可以透過這個AI工具設計出更精準的載體，把藥物準確送到病灶，提高治療效果，就像導彈一樣精準。

title: Chemical Properties-Based Deep Learning Models for Recommending Rational Daily Diet Combinations to Diabetics Through Large-Scale Virtual Screening of α-Glucosidase Dietary-Derived Inhibitors and Verified In Vitro.
summary: The lack of suitable chemical research methodologies has hindered the discovery of rational daily diet combinations from large-scale dietary-derived compounds. Three deep learning models based on chemical properties for α-glucosidase inhibitors (AGIs), safety, and drug-drug interaction (DDI) were trained. The trained models screened potential AGIs from the FooDB database (approximately 70,000 food-derived compounds) and analyzed the interactions of the selected AGIs. 59 of the 75 selected AGIs from the FooDB database had not been reported before. Betulinic acid in combination with taraxasterol, betulin, and lupeol (all selected from the potential 75 AGIs) was predicted to have a synergistic effect in enhancing the inhibition of α-glucosidase, which was further confirmed by in vitro assays. These collective findings strongly suggest that the potential of deep learning methods based on chemical properties in solving the food chemistry research challenge of developing reasonable daily diet combinations.

title_zh: 基於化學性質的深度學習模型，通過大規模虛擬篩選α-葡萄糖苷酶膳食來源抑制劑，為糖尿病患者推薦合理的每日飲食組合，並通過體外實驗驗證
summary_zh: 本研究利用深度學習，開發了三個基於化學性質的模型，分別預測α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制劑的活性、安全性以及藥物交互作用。這些模型從包含約7萬種食物成分的FooDB資料庫中篩選出潛在的α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制劑，並分析它們之間的相互作用。結果發現，有59種化合物是首次被報導具有抑制α-葡萄糖苷酶的潛力。研究進一步發現，樺木酸與蒲公英甾醇、樺木醇和羽扇豆醇組合使用，能產生協同效應，更有效地抑制α-葡萄糖苷酶的活性，並通過體外實驗證實了這一點。這項研究表明，基於化學性質的深度學習方法在解決食物化學研究中的挑戰，即開發合理的每日飲食組合方面，具有巨大的潛力。
applications: 想像一下，未來我們可以透過手機APP，輸入你的個人健康數據，APP就能根據最新的醫學研究，為你量身打造一份降血糖的每日菜單，讓你吃得健康又安心！
食品公司可以利用這項技術，開發出更有效的糖尿病保健食品。例如，將不同天然食物萃取物，以最佳比例混合，達到更好的降血糖效果。
醫生或營養師可以利用這個模型，快速分析病患的飲食習慣，找出潛在的升糖風險，並給予更精準的飲食建議，幫助病患更好地控制血糖。

title: CROI 2025: tuberculosis, Mpox, and other infectious complications in people with HIV.
summary: Updated strategies and new insights into tuberculosis and mpox treatment were a major focus at the 2025 Conference on Retroviruses and Opportunistic Infections, headlined by findings that high-dose rifampicin plus levofloxacin increased early mortality in hospitalized people with HIV with disseminated tuberculosis, whereas tecovirimat demonstrated no efficacy for clade II mpox. Herein, we summarize clinically relevant updates related to tuberculosis, mpox, Kaposi sarcoma, human papillomavirus, and other HIV-associated infectious complications presented at the conference.

title_zh: CROI 2025：愛滋病毒感染者之結核病、猴痘及其他感染性併發症
summary_zh: 2025年逆轉錄病毒和伺機性感染會議（CROI）重點關注結核病和猴痘的最新治療策略。研究發現，對於患有播散性結核病的愛滋病毒住院患者，高劑量利福平聯合左氧氟沙星會增加早期死亡率。同時，替考韋瑞對第二分支猴痘病毒無效。本次會議還更新了與結核病、猴痘、卡波西肉瘤、人類乳突病毒及其他與愛滋病毒相關的感染性併發症相關的臨床資訊。總體而言，這些研究成果有助於醫生更好地了解和治療愛滋病毒感染者常見的感染性疾病，從而改善患者的預後和生活品質。
applications: 如果您的親友是愛滋病毒感染者，且不幸感染了結核病，醫生在選擇藥物時會更加謹慎，避免使用高劑量利福平聯合左氧氟沙星，以降低死亡風險。
如果未來爆發猴痘疫情，即使感染者是愛滋病毒感染者，醫生也不會考慮使用替考韋瑞進行治療，因為研究顯示它對特定類型的猴痘病毒無效，醫生會尋找其他更有效的治療方法。
這項研究提醒我們，愛滋病毒感染者更容易受到多種感染性疾病的威脅。因此，定期篩檢和及早治療對於預防併發症至關重要，有助於他們維持健康的生活。

title: Using Māori community aspirations to advocate for oral health integration into diabetes care.
summary:
AIM: Diabetes and periodontal disease are two chronic diseases that disproportionately impact Māori in Aotearoa New Zealand. This study aimed to identify the aspirations of Māori adults with diabetes and their whānau regarding integrating oral health into diabetes management.
METHOD: This Kaupapa Māori research engaged with Māori adults diagnosed with diabetes and their whānau across two community wānanga in Porirua. Both wānanga were audio recorded and transcribed verbatim. The researchers conducted a thematic analysis to identify key themes reflecting the participants' aspirations regarding oral healthcare within the context of their diabetes management.
RESULTS: The aspirations of 26 participants were captured in the study. Māori adults with diabetes experience several barriers to accessing dental care and they outlined opportunities to integrate oral healthcare into managing diabetes health, including: need for multidisciplinary care, improved access to education and information on the impact of diabetes on oral health and connection to Te Ao Māori.
CONCLUSION: Despite the impact of diabetes on periodontal disease, oral health seldom features in diabetes management and care. Māori community aspirations highlight the urgent need for oral health to be integrated into diabetes management.

title_zh: 運用毛利社群的期望，倡議將口腔健康整合至糖尿病照護中
summary_zh: 本研究旨在了解紐西蘭毛利族糖尿病患者及其家庭，對於將口腔健康納入糖尿病管理的期望。研究透過社區工作坊，收集了26位參與者的意見。結果顯示，毛利族糖尿病患者在獲得牙科照護方面面臨許多阻礙。他們期望能整合口腔健康照護至糖尿病管理中，包括：提供跨領域照護、加強糖尿病對口腔健康影響的教育資訊，並連結毛利文化。研究強調，儘管糖尿病會影響牙周病，口腔健康卻很少被納入糖尿病管理中。毛利社群的期望突顯了將口腔健康整合至糖尿病管理的迫切性。
applications: 想像一下，如果糖尿病患在看糖尿病門診時，也能同時獲得牙醫的諮詢和檢查，早期發現並處理牙齦問題，是不是能更全面地照顧他們的健康？
如果社區健康中心能提供結合糖尿病和口腔健康教育的課程，讓大家更了解糖尿病對牙齒的影響，並學習如何正確照護口腔，就能有效預防牙周病惡化。
透過結合毛利傳統文化和現代醫療，為毛利族糖尿病患者提供更適切的口腔健康照護，例如，運用傳統草藥舒緩牙齦不適，或由部落長老提供心理支持，讓他們更願意接受治療。

title: Reflection on clinical and methodological issues in rare disease clinical trials.
summary: Rare diseases present critical challenges to healthcare systems, patients, and caregivers due to their low prevalence and unique characteristics. Designing clinical trials and developing statistical methodologies for evaluating interventions in rare diseases face several challenges. The "EBStatMax" project, part of the European Joint Programme on Rare Diseases' Demonstration Projects, aimed to address one of these challenges, namely: designing and analyzing longitudinal cross-over data in rare diseases, like Epidermolysis bullosa simplex (EBS). Although the main findings of the project have been published elsewhere, this manuscript reflects on additional hurdles encountered during the project, particularly regarding outcomes and methodological considerations. It explores issues surrounding outcome measurement, statistical methodology, and clinical considerations, emphasizing their broader relevance to methodological advancements in rare disease research beyond this specific case. This manuscript highlights the critical role of international collaboration in rare disease research to enhance evidence quality and aims to inspire further advancements in the field.
